title: 聊時事說出自己的看法
subtitle: 12 句英文，不再只會說 it's good

lines.say: Did you see the news? They want to try a four-day working week here. What do you think?
lines.zh: 你有看新聞嗎？這裡想試行一週上四天班。你覺得呢？

lines.say: Em… it's good. Yes. Good.
lines.zh: 呃……很好。對，很好。

lines.say: In my own language, I could talk about this for an hour. In English, all I had was: it's good.
lines.zh: 用母語，這種話題我可以聊一小時。用英文，我只有一句：很好。

lines.say: My friend changed the subject. She thought I didn't care. I cared a lot!
lines.zh: 我朋友換了話題，她以為我不在乎。我超在乎的！

board.cta: 聊時事說出自己的看法・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for talking about the news with friends.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你跟朋友聊時事的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for talking about the news with friends.

lines.say: How to give an opinion, how to sound less certain, how to disagree with a friend, and how to change your mind.
lines.zh: 怎麼表達看法、怎麼留點餘地、怎麼跟朋友意見不同，還有怎麼改變想法。

scenes.title: Have a view
scenes.sub: 表達看法：有立場，也有理由

lines.say: Part one: have a view.
lines.zh: 第一段：說出你的看法。

lines.say: An opinion has two parts: what you think, and why. Most learners stop after the first part.
lines.zh: 一個看法有兩部分：你怎麼想，還有為什麼。大部分學習者講完第一部分就停了。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Personally, I think it's a great idea.
scenes.meaning: 我個人覺得這是個好主意

lines.say: Personally, I think it's a great idea.
Personally shows this is your view, not a fact. It invites other views.
lines.zh: Personally 表示這是你的看法，不是事實，也歡迎別人有不同意見。

lines.say: But don't stop there. Your friend is waiting for the because.
lines.zh: 但不要停在這裡，朋友在等你的 because。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Personally, I think it's a great idea.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: The way I see it, people would be happier and work better.
scenes.meaning: 在我看來，大家會更快樂，工作也會更好
scenes.note: The way I see it ＝ 在我看來

lines.say: Then give your reason.
lines.zh: 接著說理由。

lines.say: The way I see it, people would be happier and work better.
The way I see it introduces your reasoning. It sounds thoughtful.
lines.zh: The way I see it 帶出你的理由，聽起來很有想法。

lines.say: Two reasons is perfect. Three is a speech!
lines.zh: 兩個理由剛好，三個就變演講了！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: The way I see it, people would be happier and work better.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I read somewhere that it worked really well in Iceland.
scenes.meaning: 我在哪裡看到，冰島試行得很成功
scenes.note: I read somewhere that ＝ 我在哪裡讀到……

lines.say: And if you read something about it, use it.
lines.zh: 如果你有讀過相關的東西，就拿出來用。

lines.say: I read somewhere that it worked really well in Iceland.
I read somewhere is great when you don't remember exactly where. Very honest.
lines.zh: I read somewhere 很適合用在你記不清楚出處的時候，很誠實。

lines.say: This is exactly why reading the news in English helps you speak. Hint, hint.
lines.zh: 這就是讀英文新聞能幫你開口的原因。你懂的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I read somewhere that it worked really well in Iceland.

scenes.title: Soften it
scenes.sub: 留點餘地：不要說得太滿

lines.say: Part two: soften it.
lines.zh: 第二段：留點餘地。

lines.say: In English, sounding too sure can sound rude. Small words make a big difference.
lines.zh: 在英文裡，講得太肯定可能顯得沒禮貌。小字有大作用。

items: ✓ It could be better, depending on…

lines.say: Definitely leaves no room for your friend.
lines.zh: definitely 不給朋友留任何空間。

lines.say: Soft words keep the conversation open.
lines.zh: 柔和的字讓對話保持開放。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: It depends on the job, really.

lines.say: It depends on the job, really.
It depends on shows you've thought about different situations.
lines.zh: It depends on 表示你考慮過不同情況。

lines.say: Really at the end makes it sound relaxed and natural.
lines.zh: 最後加 really，聽起來輕鬆又自然。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It depends on the job, really.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: I can see it working for offices, but maybe not for hospitals.
scenes.meaning: 我覺得辦公室可行，但醫院可能不行
scenes.note: I can see it working ＝ 我覺得行得通

lines.say: Then show both sides.
lines.zh: 接著說兩面。

lines.say: I can see it working for offices, but maybe not for hospitals.
I can see it working means I can imagine it being successful.
lines.zh: I can see it working 是我想像得到它會成功。

lines.say: Giving both sides makes you sound fair, and much smarter.
lines.zh: 說出兩面讓你聽起來公平，也更聰明。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I can see it working for offices, but maybe not for hospitals.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I'm not 100% sure, but I don't think it's that simple.
scenes.meaning: 我不是百分之百確定，但我覺得沒那麼簡單

lines.say: And when you're doubtful, say so honestly.
lines.zh: 如果你有懷疑，就老實說。

lines.say: I'm not 100% sure, but I don't think it's that simple.
I'm not 100% sure is honest and humble. People trust it.
lines.zh: I'm not 100% sure 誠實又謙虛，大家會信任你。

lines.say: Not that simple means more complicated than it looks.
lines.zh: not that simple 是比看起來複雜。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm not 100% sure, but I don't think it's that simple.
Let's try that chat again.
lines.zh: 我們重聊一次。

lines.say: A four-day working week. What do you think?
lines.zh: 一週上四天班，你覺得呢？

lines.say: Personally, I think it's a great idea. The way I see it, people would be happier and work better.
lines.zh: 我個人覺得這是個好主意。在我看來，大家會更快樂，工作也會更好。

lines.say: Even nurses? Even shops?
lines.zh: 連護理師也是？商店也是？

lines.say: It depends on the job, really. I can see it working for offices, but maybe not for hospitals.
lines.zh: 其實要看是什麼工作。我覺得辦公室可行，但醫院可能不行。

lines.say: Hmm, that's true.
lines.zh: 嗯，有道理。

lines.say: Now it's a real conversation.
lines.zh: 現在這才是真正的聊天。

scenes.title: Push back
scenes.sub: 跟朋友意見不同：友善地反駁

lines.say: Part three: push back.
lines.zh: 第三段：友善地反駁。

lines.say: Disagreeing with a friend is normal. It's how good conversations happen.
lines.zh: 跟朋友意見不同很正常，好的對話就是這樣來的。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Really? I'm not so sure about that.
scenes.meaning: 真的嗎？這我倒不太確定
scenes.note: I'm not so sure about that ＝ 我不太同意

lines.say: Really? I'm not so sure about that.
I'm not so sure about that is the friendliest way to say I disagree.
lines.zh: I'm not so sure about that 是說「我不同意」最友善的方式。

lines.say: Say it with a smile, and a little laugh. Friends do this all the time.
lines.zh: 帶著微笑、輕輕一笑地說。朋友之間常這樣。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Really? I'm not so sure about that.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: But what about people who are paid by the hour?

lines.say: Then ask a question, instead of making a statement.
lines.zh: 接著用問題代替陳述。

lines.say: But what about people who are paid by the hour?
What about is a gentle way to bring up a problem.
lines.zh: What about 是溫和地提出問題的方法。

lines.say: Questions feel like curiosity. Statements feel like a fight.
lines.zh: 問題感覺像好奇，陳述感覺像吵架。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: But what about people who are paid by the hour?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: I take your point, but I still think the risk is too high.
scenes.meaning: 我懂你的意思，但我還是覺得風險太高
scenes.note: I take your point ＝ 我明白你的意思

lines.say: And when you really disagree, be clear, but kind.
lines.zh: 真的不同意時，清楚但友善地說。

lines.say: I take your point, but I still think the risk is too high.
I take your point means I understand and respect your argument.
lines.zh: I take your point 是我理解也尊重你的論點。

lines.say: But I still think keeps your opinion. Both of you can be smart and still disagree.
lines.zh: But I still think 保住你的看法。兩個聰明人也可以意見不同。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I take your point, but I still think the risk is too high.

scenes.title: Wrap it up
scenes.sub: 收尾：改變想法、讓話題延續

lines.say: Part four: wrap it up.
lines.zh: 第四段：收尾。

lines.say: A good chat doesn't need a winner.
lines.zh: 好的聊天不需要贏家。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of it like that.
scenes.meaning: 說得好，我沒從這個角度想過
scenes.note: think of it like that ＝ 從那個角度想

lines.say: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of it like that.
Changing your mind is not losing. It's listening.
lines.zh: 改變想法不是輸，是有在聽。

lines.say: People love talking to someone who can say this.
lines.zh: 大家都喜歡跟說得出這句話的人聊天。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of it like that.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: I suppose we'll have to wait and see.
scenes.meaning: 我想我們只能等著看了
scenes.note: wait and see ＝ 等著看結果

lines.say: When there's no answer yet, end it like this.
lines.zh: 還沒有答案時，就這樣結束。

lines.say: I suppose we'll have to wait and see.
I suppose means I think, but not strongly. Wait and see means let's see what happens.
lines.zh: I suppose 是我想（不強烈），wait and see 是看看會怎樣。

lines.say: It closes the topic without anyone losing.
lines.zh: 這句話結束話題，沒有人輸。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I suppose we'll have to wait and see.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: What's everyone at your work saying about it?
scenes.note: What's everyone saying ＝ 大家怎麼說

lines.say: And keep the conversation going, with one more question.
lines.zh: 再用一個問題讓對話繼續。

lines.say: What's everyone at your work saying about it?
Asking about other people's opinions is a safe, easy next step.
lines.zh: 問別人的看法，是安全又簡單的下一步。

lines.say: Now your friend talks, and you rest. Clever!
lines.zh: 現在換朋友說，你休息。很聰明！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What's everyone at your work saying about it?
But what about people who are paid by the hour?
lines.zh: 那時薪制的人怎麼辦？

lines.say: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of it like that.
lines.zh: 說得好，我沒從這個角度想過。

lines.say: Mm. They'd lose money.
lines.zh: 嗯，他們會少賺錢。

lines.say: I suppose we'll have to wait and see. What's everyone at your work saying about it?
lines.zh: 我想我們只能等著看了。你公司的人都怎麼說？

lines.say: Oh, don't get me started!
lines.zh: 喔，別讓我開始講！

lines.say: And off she goes. A real conversation, in English.
lines.zh: 然後她就開始講了。這是一場真正的英文對話。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：聊天時的兩句口頭禪

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish phrases for chatting about the news.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！聊時事時的兩句愛爾蘭口頭禪。

lines.say: In Ireland, dead can mean very. So dead right means completely right.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，dead 可以是「非常」的意思。dead right 就是完全正確。

lines.say: You're dead right.
You'll also hear dead easy, and dead on. Nothing to do with dying!
lines.zh: 你也會聽到 dead easy、dead on，跟死掉一點關係都沒有！

board.kicker: When the topic is too big

lines.say: And when someone has very strong feelings about a topic, they say this.
lines.zh: 當有人對某個話題非常有感，會這樣說。

lines.say: Don't get me started!
It means: I have so much to say. And then, of course, they start.
lines.zh: 意思是：我有好多話要說。然後當然，他們就開始說了。

lines.say: Don't get me started!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：一杯咖啡聊完一則新聞

lines.say: Back to the café one more time. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 再回到咖啡店一次。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Did you see the news? What do you think?
lines.zh: 你有看新聞嗎？你覺得呢？

lines.say: Personally, I think it's a great idea. I read somewhere that it worked really well in Iceland.
lines.zh: 我個人覺得這是個好主意。我在哪裡看到，冰島試行得很成功。

lines.say: Really? I'm not so sure about that.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？這我倒不太確定。

lines.say: I take your point. It depends on the job, really.
lines.zh: 我懂你的意思。其實要看是什麼工作。

lines.say: You're dead right there.
lines.zh: 這點你完全說對了。

items: Personally, I think it's a great idea.
The way I see it, people would be happier and work better.
I read somewhere that it worked really well in Iceland.
It depends on the job, really.
I can see it working for offices, but maybe not for hospitals.
I'm not 100% sure, but I don't think it's that simple.
Really? I'm not so sure about that.
But what about people who are paid by the hour?
I take your point, but I still think the risk is too high.
That's a good point. I hadn't thought of it like that.
I suppose we'll have to wait and see.
What's everyone at your work saying about it?

lines.say: Opinions, reasons, and a friendly argument. Brilliant!
lines.zh: 有看法、有理由，還有一場友善的辯論。太棒了！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, and try them on the next news story you read.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖下來，下一則新聞就拿來試試。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: Then you'll always have something to talk about. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 這樣你永遠都有話題可以聊。下一課見，Bye！
